inferred.claim: m1019_10 is the content that players would call the v10113 'hard mode'. It is a separate map package with a harder economy/difficulty curve, not a plugin branch or data threshold.
inferred.caveat: No local artifact contains the literal label 'hard mode'; the name is inferred from difficulty metrics and the two-map catalog.

inferred.claim: Selection of m1019_10 happens upstream of the game plugin: in the app/server dispatch, lobby, or matchmaking layer that returns mname/mid/mapUrl. It is not selected by Match.lua, GameConfig.lua, SceneConfig.lua, or a map CSV threshold.
inferred.caveat: The production g1019 dispatch implementation is not in the archive; the included game-api is a stub/hardcoded m_1008 and the Go dispatcher is a TODO.

inferred.claim: v10113 listing m1019_10 first may indicate that hard mode became the preferred/default map for new rooms, or simply a CDN/config reorder. The archive does not prove either.
inferred.caveat: No default-map, room-creation, or client-selection evidence found.

inferred.claim: m1019_2 is a future/unreleased rebalance of the hard map rather than a third mode; it reuses the hard world and tweaks levels, monster stats, arms, basement HP and rewards.
inferred.caveat: It is staging-only at v10113; no later version is in the corpus, so its release name is unknown.

inferred.claim: There is no player-level or account-level unlock gate for hard mode; if access is gated at all, it is gated by the external dispatch/rollout system, not by data in the shipped game pack.
inferred.caveat: Absence of evidence in the local pack; the production server database/feature-flag system is missing.
